+name: Agent 2 P0 Control API boundary
+on:
+  push:
+    paths:
+      - 'unified_system/control_api_readonly.py'
+      - 'tests/test_control_api_readonly.py'
+      - 'docs/architecture/control-api-readonly.md'
+      - '.github/workflows/agent2-control-api.yml'
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - 'unified_system/control_api_readonly.py'
+      - 'tests/test_control_api_readonly.py'
+      - 'docs/architecture/control-api-readonly.md'
+      - '.github/workflows/agent2-control-api.yml'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+jobs:
+  boundary:
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        os: [ubuntu-24.04, windows-latest]
+        python: ['3.11', '3.12']
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    env:
+      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
+        with:
+          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
+      - name: Denial and unavailable boundary tests (mandatory, no skips)
+        shell: python
+        run: |
+          import json, os, pathlib, platform, subprocess, unittest
+          head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
+          assert head == os.environ['EXPECTED_HEAD'], 'unexpected source head'
+          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests', pattern='test_control_api_readonly.py')
+          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
+          report = dict(schema='unified.control-api.p0-ci.v1', head=head,
+              tree=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'], text=True).strip(),
+              os=platform.system(), python=platform.python_version(), tests=result.testsRun,
+              failures=len(result.failures), errors=len(result.errors), skipped=len(result.skipped),
+              run=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], attempt=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
+              qualification='P0_COMPONENT_ONLY', runtime_api='NOT_QUALIFIED', physical='NOT_RUN', production='NO_GO')
+          pathlib.Path('p0-ci-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
+          assert result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun >= 16 and not result.skipped
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: p0-control-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.python }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: p0-ci-evidence.json
+          if-no-files-found: error

+# Control API P0 denial boundary
+
+`ControlAPIReadOnlyApp()` is a pure, no-argument WSGI application. It creates no
+listener, reads no request body, clock, files, environment or network, and has no
+provider/backend injection or enable switch. It does not authenticate an operator
+or implement distributed consensus. Startup and shared service wiring are excluded.
+
+Approved component base: `2df6f5c2f77f4d883bad1a8623dd8375db529be0`, tree
+`f10c13d2dd8a2a88fd7db9a4cf0d0e7a1cd6d0d4`. Ownership revision 3 is pinned at
+`57e8f7524912b52ebbb639bd6d5d4fd5e2961622`, ownership SHA256
+`22150f804b1b3a0d6e2047887585b1b550d189bb410fbc894ef566c553594ebe`.
+
+This slice implements the immutable P0 profile SHA256
+`e4b7f009e6f81cc5baa46be604abde8edd05cc6f48dfb5ac711879343c49d20c`.
+Its explicit error shape differs from the earlier proposed Control API spec
+`42057e45cc5a2d104fca7d59e39fd3b2ee568d9b08ee21aa6985c074987b60a8`.
+Agent 6's scoped profile/version-separation design ACK is not runtime compatibility.
+
+| Route | Method | P0 result |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `/control/v1/capabilities` | GET | 200; constant DENY_ONLY profile, all runtime capabilities false |
+| `/control/v1/snapshot`, `/control/v1/events` | GET | 503 AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE |
+| `/control/v1/datasets/{id}/snapshot`, `/control/v1/datasets/{id}/events` | GET | 503 AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE |
+| `/control/v1/commands/{uuid}` | GET | 503 AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE |
+| `/control/v1/commands`, `/control/v1/confirmations` | POST | 503 SAFETY_GATE_CLOSED |
+| `/control/v1/sessions`, `/control/v1/reauth` | POST | 503 AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE |
+| `/control/v1/sessions/current` | DELETE | 503 AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE |
+
+Wrong methods return 405 with `Allow`; unknown paths return 404. Malformed paths,
+nonempty queries, transfer encoding and any nonzero/malformed body length return
+400 without reading `wsgi.input`. This includes small bodies; no route consumes
+JSON or implements cursor/barrier query semantics in P0. Input bodies are never
+buffered, so excessive advertised lengths cannot allocate memory. Paths are bounded
+to 2048 characters, responses to small constant JSON below 4096 bytes.
+HEAD retains denial status and representation headers but never emits a response body.
+
+Errors have exactly `schema`, `code`, `retryable`, `request_id`. Schema is
+`unified.control-error.p0.v1`; retryable is false and request_id is null. No UUID,
+identity or authority evidence is fabricated to fit a consumer schema. Responses
+use no-store/nosniff headers and never echo request secrets, paths or query values.
+
+This profile is intentionally incompatible with frozen Terminan Sync v1 error and
+event schemas. No transport adapter is installed. A client may display local
+UNAVAILABLE on 503/unsupported schema; it cannot interpret denial as NO_QUORUM,
+authenticated session expiry, empty snapshot, receipt or valid cursor. A bare
+command UUID cannot select a future wire-v2 receipt without resolving its original
+generation/actor/operation/request binding; this implementation performs no lookup.
+
+Both strict-time and closure/eligibility/allocation gates remain closed for every
+mutation, including adoption, completion and release. Egress dispatch containment
+remains unproven. This app supplies no read barrier, retention, freshness, RBAC,
+Windows SSPI provider or endpoint availability evidence. Future read-success
+profiles require exact source-owned immutable projections and versioned consumer
+ACKs; timestamps, fixture providers and node certificates cannot unlock them.
+
+Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_control_api_readonly.py -v`.
+Tests exercise real WSGI responses and negative inputs without starting a service.
+The dedicated Linux/Windows matrix qualifies only this P0 component; it is not
+physical HA, Windows identity, real Control API integration or production acceptance.

+"""P0 boundary tests: real WSGI responses, no server or production fixtures."""
+import json
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from unified_system.control_api_readonly import ControlAPIReadOnlyApp
+
+
+class UnreadableBody:
+    def read(self, *args):
+        raise AssertionError('P0 must never read request bodies')
+
+
+class ControlAPITest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def request(self, method='GET', path='/control/v1/capabilities', **extra):
+        environ = {'REQUEST_METHOD': method, 'PATH_INFO': path,
+                   'QUERY_STRING': '', 'CONTENT_LENGTH': '',
+                   'wsgi.input': UnreadableBody()}
+        environ.update(extra)
+        captured = []
+        def start_response(status, headers):
+            captured.append((status, dict(headers)))
+        chunks = list(ControlAPIReadOnlyApp()(environ, start_response))
+        self.assertEqual(len(captured), 1)
+        self.assertTrue(all(type(chunk) is bytes for chunk in chunks))
+        body = b''.join(chunks)
+        status, headers = captured[0]
+        self.assertLessEqual(len(body), 4096)
+        self.assertEqual(headers['Content-Length'], str(len(body)))
+        self.assertEqual(headers['Content-Type'], 'application/json')
+        self.assertEqual(headers['Cache-Control'], 'no-store')
+        self.assertEqual(headers['X-Content-Type-Options'], 'nosniff')
+        return int(status[:3]), headers, json.loads(body)
+
+    def test_public_capabilities_never_claim_admitted_runtime(self):
+        status, _, value = self.request()
+        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
+        self.assertEqual(value, {
+            'schema': 'unified.control-capabilities.v1', 'api_version': 1,
+            'profile': 'DENY_ONLY', 'authentication_available': False,
+            'authority_reads_available': False, 'mutations_available': False,
+            'snapshots_available': False, 'events_available': False})
+
+    def test_all_protected_reads_are_unavailable_not_empty_success(self):
+        for path in ('/control/v1/snapshot', '/control/v1/events',
+                     '/control/v1/datasets/dataset-1/snapshot',
+                     '/control/v1/datasets/dataset-1/events',
+                     '/control/v1/commands/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'):
+            with self.subTest(path=path):
+                status, _, value = self.request(path=path)
+                self.assertEqual(status, 503)
+                self.assertEqual(value['code'], 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE')
+                self.assertNotIn('resources', value)
+                self.assertNotIn('cursor', value)
+
+    def test_every_effect_route_stays_denied(self):
+        for method, path, code in (
+            ('POST', '/control/v1/commands', 'SAFETY_GATE_CLOSED'),
+            ('POST', '/control/v1/sessions', 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE'),
+            ('POST', '/control/v1/reauth', 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE'),
+            ('POST', '/control/v1/confirmations', 'SAFETY_GATE_CLOSED'),
+            ('DELETE', '/control/v1/sessions/current', 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE')):
+            with self.subTest(path=path):
+                status, _, value = self.request(method, path)
+                self.assertEqual((status, value['code']), (503, code))
+
+    def test_claimed_principal_cookie_and_truthy_flags_do_not_authenticate(self):
+        with patch.dict('os.environ', {'CONTROL_API_ENABLED': 'true', 'ROLE': 'SystemOwner'}):
+            status, _, value = self.request(path='/control/v1/snapshot',
+                HTTP_AUTHORIZATION='Bearer secret-value', REMOTE_USER='Administrator',
+                HTTP_X_ROLE='SystemOwner', HTTP_COOKIE='session=secret-value')
+        self.assertEqual((status, value['code']), (503, 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE'))
+        self.assertNotIn('secret-value', json.dumps(value))
+        self.assertNotIn('Administrator', json.dumps(value))
+
+    def test_no_provider_or_backend_activation_constructor(self):
+        for name in ('provider', 'backend', 'verifier', 'enabled'):
+            with self.subTest(name=name), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
+                ControlAPIReadOnlyApp(**{name: True})
+
+    def test_wrong_method_returns_allow_without_activation(self):
+        status, headers, value = self.request('POST')
+        self.assertEqual((status, value['code']), (405, 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED'))
+        self.assertEqual(headers['Allow'], 'GET')
+
+    def test_unknown_route_does_not_look_like_missing_auth(self):
+        status, _, value = self.request(path='/control/v1/unknown')
+        self.assertEqual((status, value['code']), (404, 'NOT_FOUND'))
+
+    def test_queries_are_not_treated_as_implemented_resume_or_barrier(self):
+        for path, query in (('/control/v1/capabilities', 'enabled=true'),
+                            ('/control/v1/events', 'cursor=secret-cursor'),
+                            ('/control/v1/datasets/d/snapshot', 'metadata_revision=1')):
+            with self.subTest(path=path):
+                status, _, value = self.request(path=path, QUERY_STRING=query)
+                self.assertEqual((status, value['code']), (400, 'INVALID_REQUEST'))
+                self.assertNotIn(query, json.dumps(value))
+
+    def test_nonempty_and_ambiguous_body_framing_denied_without_read(self):
+        for extra in ({'CONTENT_LENGTH': '1'}, {'CONTENT_LENGTH': '-1'},
+                      {'CONTENT_LENGTH': '0,0'}, {'CONTENT_LENGTH': ' 0'},
+                      {'CONTENT_LENGTH': '00'}, {'CONTENT_LENGTH': 'x'},
+                      {'HTTP_TRANSFER_ENCODING': 'chunked'}):
+            with self.subTest(extra=extra):
+                status, _, value = self.request(**extra)
+                self.assertEqual((status, value['code']), (400, 'INVALID_REQUEST'))
+
+    def test_oversize_body_claim_rejected_before_buffering(self):
+        status, _, value = self.request(CONTENT_LENGTH='32769')
+        self.assertEqual((status, value['code']), (400, 'INVALID_REQUEST'))
+        status, _, _ = self.request(CONTENT_LENGTH='9' * 10000)
+        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
+
+    def test_malformed_wsgi_fields_fail_closed(self):
+        for extra in ({'PATH_INFO': None}, {'REQUEST_METHOD': None},
+                      {'QUERY_STRING': None}, {'CONTENT_LENGTH': 0}):
+            with self.subTest(extra=extra):
+                status, _, value = self.request(**extra)
+                self.assertEqual((status, value['code']), (400, 'INVALID_REQUEST'))
+
+    def test_encoded_traversal_slashes_unicode_and_long_paths_are_invalid(self):
+        for path in ('/control/v1/datasets/../snapshot',
+                     '/control/v1/datasets/x%2Fy/snapshot',
+                     '/control/v1/datasets/x\\y/snapshot',
+                     '/control/v1/datasets/тест/snapshot',
+                     '/control/v1/snapshot\x00', '/' + 'a' * 2048):
+            with self.subTest(path=path):
+                status, _, value = self.request(path=path)
+                self.assertEqual((status, value['code']), (400, 'INVALID_REQUEST'))
+
+    def test_error_envelope_has_no_fabricated_authority_or_request_identity(self):
+        _, _, value = self.request(path='/control/v1/snapshot')
+        self.assertEqual(value, {'schema': 'unified.control-error.p0.v1',
+            'code': 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE', 'retryable': False,
+            'request_id': None})
+
+    def test_mutating_returned_json_cannot_enable_later_requests(self):
+        _, _, value = self.request()
+        value['mutations_available'] = True
+        status, _, result = self.request('POST', '/control/v1/commands')
+        self.assertEqual((status, result['code']), (503, 'SAFETY_GATE_CLOSED'))
+
+    def test_boundary_does_not_open_files_sockets_or_read_system_time(self):
+        with patch('builtins.open', side_effect=AssertionError('file access')), \
+             patch('socket.socket', side_effect=AssertionError('socket access')), \
+             patch('time.time', side_effect=AssertionError('clock access')):
+            status, _, _ = self.request()
+            denied, _, _ = self.request('POST', '/control/v1/commands')
+        self.assertEqual((status, denied), (200, 503))
+
+    def test_head_errors_never_send_a_response_body(self):
+        for path, expected in (('/control/v1/capabilities', 405),
+                               ('/control/v1/unknown', 404),
+                               ('/control/v1/%bad', 400)):
+            with self.subTest(path=path):
+                captured = []
+                response = ControlAPIReadOnlyApp()(
+                    {'REQUEST_METHOD': 'HEAD', 'PATH_INFO': path},
+                    lambda status, headers: captured.append((status, dict(headers))))
+                self.assertEqual(int(captured[0][0][:3]), expected)
+                self.assertEqual(b''.join(response), b'')
+                self.assertEqual(captured[0][1]['Cache-Control'], 'no-store')
+                self.assertLessEqual(int(captured[0][1]['Content-Length']), 4096)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()

+"""Pure P0 WSGI denial boundary, not an admitted Control API service.
+
+No listener, identity verifier, backend, clock or activation switch. The P0 error
+profile is intentionally distinct from Terminan Sync v1 and carries no authority.
+"""
+import json
+import re
+
+
+_ROOT = '/control/v1/'
+_ID = r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}'
+_DATASET = re.compile(_ROOT + r'datasets/' + _ID + r'/(?:snapshot|events)\Z')
+_COMMAND = re.compile(_ROOT + r'commands/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}'
+                      r'-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\Z')
+_ROUTES = {
+    _ROOT + 'capabilities': ('GET', None),
+    _ROOT + 'snapshot': ('GET', 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE'),
+    _ROOT + 'events': ('GET', 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE'),
+    _ROOT + 'commands': ('POST', 'SAFETY_GATE_CLOSED'),
+    _ROOT + 'sessions': ('POST', 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE'),
+    _ROOT + 'reauth': ('POST', 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE'),
+    _ROOT + 'confirmations': ('POST', 'SAFETY_GATE_CLOSED'),
+    _ROOT + 'sessions/current': ('DELETE', 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE'),
+}
+_LABELS = {200: 'OK', 400: 'Bad Request', 404: 'Not Found',
+           405: 'Method Not Allowed', 503: 'Service Unavailable'}
+
+
+class ControlAPIReadOnlyApp:
+    """No-argument deny-only application; credentials cannot enable a backend."""
+
+    def __call__(self, environ, start_response):
+        method = environ.get('REQUEST_METHOD')
+        path = environ.get('PATH_INFO')
+        query = environ.get('QUERY_STRING', '')
+        length = environ.get('CONTENT_LENGTH', '')
+        # No enabled route consumes a request body. Reject framing without ever
+        # reading wsgi.input, even for malformed JSON or a streaming request.
+        valid = (
+            type(method) is str and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z]{1,16}', method)
+            and type(path) is str and 0 < len(path) <= 2048
+            and re.fullmatch(r'/[A-Za-z0-9/._:-]*', path)
+            and not any(part in ('.', '..') for part in path.split('/'))
+            and type(query) is str and not query
+            and type(length) is str and length in ('', '0')
+            and 'HTTP_TRANSFER_ENCODING' not in environ
+        )
+        status, code, allowed = 400, 'INVALID_REQUEST', None
+        if valid:
+            route = _ROUTES.get(path)
+            if route is None and (_DATASET.fullmatch(path) or _COMMAND.fullmatch(path)):
+                route = ('GET', 'AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE')
+            if route is None:
+                status, code = 404, 'NOT_FOUND'
+            elif method != route[0]:
+                status, code, allowed = 405, 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', route[0]
+            elif route[1] is None:
+                status, code = 200, None
+            else:
+                status, code = 503, route[1]
+
+        if status == 200:
+            result = {
+                'schema': 'unified.control-capabilities.v1', 'api_version': 1,
+                'profile': 'DENY_ONLY', 'authentication_available': False,
+                'authority_reads_available': False, 'mutations_available': False,
+                'snapshots_available': False, 'events_available': False,
+            }
+        else:
+            result = {'schema': 'unified.control-error.p0.v1', 'code': code,
+                      'retryable': False, 'request_id': None}
+        body = json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'),
+                          allow_nan=False).encode('ascii')
+        headers = [('Content-Type', 'application/json'),
+                   ('Content-Length', str(len(body))),
+                   ('Cache-Control', 'no-store'),
+                   ('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff')]
+        if allowed is not None:
+            headers.append(('Allow', allowed))
+        start_response(str(status) + ' ' + _LABELS[status], headers)
+        # HEAD preserves response metadata, but HTTP forbids response content
+        # even when this method or path was denied.
+        return [] if method == 'HEAD' else [body]
